title: Canonical etale to pro-etale support comparison unit
statement: For a commutative ring A, a scheme T, and a closed immersion i : Z ⟶ T, using [def-pur-support-cohomology] and [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], define the canonical ordinary support comparison unit from the etale supported-sections kernel to the pro-etale supported-sections functor as the unique map normalized by the adjunction unit on sections and the kernel inclusion [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].
